_comment: Counter catalog (real data drives the schema). Counters are the shops and temples encountered behind town tiles. Each has an id, name, description, and either an `items` stock list (regular shops) or `kind: "service"` plus a `services` menu (temples). Stock entries are Item `id` strings (snake_case) — same convention Character/Party records are starting to adopt. Duplicates are intentional: they control stocking weight (four `cloth` and two `plate` means the shop seeds with that mix). v1's TS also used the general/weapon/armor counters' `items` arrays as the post-combat loot pool; if v2 keeps that double-duty, document it explicitly when the loot path is wired up.

counters.name: General Store
counters.description: Sells supplies, tools, and everyday adventuring gear.

counters.name: Guild Hall
counters.description: Specialised equipment and services for guild members.

counters.name: Healing Counter
counters.description: A temple healer who mends flesh, restores the arcane, purges poison, and — for a price — returns the dead to life.

services.name: Heal All HP
services.description: Restore every living member to full hit points.

services.name: Restore All MP
services.description: Refill every living member's magic points.

services.name: Cure All Poisons
services.description: Cleanse poison from every party member.

services.name: Raise Dead
services.description: Return a fallen ally to full health. Costly miracle.

counters.name: Inn
counters.description: Offers rest and refreshment for weary travelers.

counters.name: Magic Shop
counters.description: Sells scrolls, potions, and enchanted goods.

counters.name: Reagent Shop
counters.description: Sells magical reagents and alchemical ingredients.

counters.name: Weapons Shop
counters.description: Sells melee and ranged weapons for all classes.
